description: Without trusted-upstream mode, a visitor can't choose their country, client IP or site with the headers an upstream would send (x-sid-country, x-sid-client-ip, x-sid-upstream-auth): the platform's own location (the cf-* headers, which each target turns into its platform's; the Node.js target reads them with SID_TRUST_PROXY) still decides GDPR, so an EU visitor claiming to be in the US gets no ID cookies without a TC string.

cases.name: a forged country doesn't override the platform's EU country
the payload has the platform's location, not the forged one
